name: VoidMarch
summary: VoidMarch is a free-to-play multiplayer space strategy game for iPhone, iPad and Android, set in a persistent universe. Players start with one planet, develop mines, manage energy and invest resources in research, ships and defenses. Mines keep producing and fleets keep moving while a player is away, and planets can be attacked while their owner is offline. Players scout other commanders, plan attacks, send recyclers to recover debris after battle, and protect their fleets by keeping them in flight. Pirate excavations are contested sites: a fleet defeats the defenders and holds the site while cargo ships extract resources, and other commanders can challenge the hold. Players can act alone or join alliances in the same shared universe.
